text: Jelinek said he didn’t know; he seemed to remember hearing there had once been such a custom in Bohemia. Shimerda is made up her mind,’ he added. ‘I try to persuade her, and say it looks bad for her to all the neighbours; but she say so it must be. “There I will bury him, if I dig the grave myself,” she say. I have to promise her I help Ambrosch make the grave tomorrow.’ Grandfather smoothed his beard and looked judicial.
